Frequently.title: How much does cryptocurrency exchange development cost?
Frequently.desc: Cryptocurrency exchange development cost ranges from $15,000–$40,000 for a white-label solution to $80,000–$300,000+ for a fully custom-built centralized or decentralized exchange. Key cost drivers include exchange type (CEX vs DEX vs hybrid), number of trading pairs, security audit scope, mobile app requirements, and compliance integrations. Comfygen provides a detailed, component-by-component cost estimate within 48 hours of your initial consultation.

Frequently.title: How long does it take to build a cryptocurrency exchange platform?
Frequently.desc: A white label crypto exchange can be deployed in 6–8 weeks. A custom-built centralized exchange typically takes 16–24 weeks end-to-end, including design, development, smart contract audit, and testing. Decentralized and hybrid exchanges depend on chain complexity but generally fall within the same range. The timeline is confirmed during the architecture review phase.

Frequently.title: What is the difference between a CEX and a DEX, and which should I build?
Frequently.desc: A centralized exchange (CEX) uses an internal order book and custodial wallets — offering higher liquidity, faster execution, and a simpler user experience, but requiring more compliance infrastructure. A decentralized exchange (DEX) operates via smart contracts with non-custodial wallets — offering greater privacy and censorship resistance but typically lower liquidity. Hybrid exchanges combine both models. The right choice depends on your target users, regulatory jurisdiction, and monetization model. Comfygen's consulting team will advise based on your specific business case.

Frequently.title: Do you provide smart contract auditing for crypto exchanges?
Frequently.desc: Yes. All DEX and hybrid exchange builds include smart contract development followed by an independent security audit before mainnet deployment. We test for re-entrancy vulnerabilities, integer overflow, access control issues, gas optimization, and logic errors. A full audit report is provided before go-live. Audit-only engagements are also available for existing smart contracts.

Frequently.title: Can Comfygen build a crypto exchange app for both iOS and Android?
Frequently.desc: Yes. Our crypto trading app development team builds cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and Flutter, deployed simultaneously to iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play). Mobile apps include real-time trading, portfolio management, push notifications, biometric authentication, and in-app KYC onboarding.

Frequently.title: What compliance and KYC/AML features are included?
Frequently.desc: All Comfygen exchange builds include integrated KYC/AML workflows: document verification, facial recognition, liveness checks, sanction screening (OFAC, EU, UN), and transaction monitoring with SAR reporting tools. We integrate with leading KYC providers including Sumsub, Onfido, and Jumio. Compliance architecture is designed to meet FATF VASP guidelines, EU MiCA requirements, and FinCEN BSA obligations.

Frequently.title: Can I white-label an existing exchange or do I need to build from scratch?
Frequently.desc: Both options are available. Our white-label crypto exchange software gives you a production-ready, fully branded platform with faster time-to-market and lower upfront cost. Custom builds offer complete control over architecture, features, and trading logic. We also offer a hybrid path: a white-label foundation with custom feature development layered on top. A discovery call will help identify the right approach for your timeline and budget.

Frequently.title: Which countries do you serve and can you help with exchange licensing?
Frequently.desc: Comfygen serves clients globally, with active projects in India, UAE, UK, USA, Canada, Germany, Nigeria, and Southeast Asia. We assist with regulatory research and connect clients with specialized legal partners for exchange licensing in relevant jurisdictions. Note: Comfygen provides technical and compliance consulting — we do not offer legal advice and recommend engaging licensed legal counsel for formal licensing applications.
